label: Dashboard
depicts: Round gauge outline with side ticks and a diagonal needle across the center
use_when: Use when the interface wants a full round gauge with a diagonal needle sweep.
avoid_when: Do not use for the open arc or ring meter variants when the full dial face matters.

label: Dashboard
depicts: Open bottom gauge arc with a centered vertical needle line
use_when: Use when the interface wants a gauge reduced to an open arc and one central needle.
avoid_when: Do not use for full circular gauges when the bottom gap in the arc should stay visible.

label: Dashboard
depicts: Round gauge outline with top ticks and a short angled center needle
use_when: Use when the interface wants a round gauge whose ticks are concentrated across the top arc.
avoid_when: Do not use for the diagonal side tick gauge when the top tick cluster is the key cue.

label: Dashboard
depicts: Concentric round gauge with inner arc bands and a short angled center needle
use_when: Use when the interface wants a round meter with nested inner arc bands around the needle.
avoid_when: Do not use for simpler gauges when the extra inner arc bands need to remain visible.

label: Counter
depicts: Square counter panel with math symbols and two short number bars inside
use_when: Use when the interface wants a counting or math panel instead of a gauge style meter.
avoid_when: Do not use for dial gauges when the square panel with symbols is the visible form.
